tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: chos bdag bar chad sel ba'i chos ka las: rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rtsa ba bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ma 'ongs bskal pa dus kyi mtha' ma la: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dug gsum gyi: 'bras bu des bskyed nad dang gdon grib sogs: khyad par slob dpon dam nyams mched lcam mkhon: dme yug mdze dang ro bag la sogs pa: rnal 'byor sgo gsum grib kyis thum pa'i ltas: bying 'thib lus lci shes rab rtsa kha zum: rtsa gsum mkha' 'gro mi dgyes mtshan ma ni: ting 'dzin bying rmugs rmi lam lus sems 'khrugs: mi rung nad dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs bskyed: gnyen por bsngags pa gsang bdag thugs kyi lha: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i nyams len dang: bum chab bkru byab gang 'dod lde kha gtod: mi gtsang sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad sel: lha dang mkha' 'gro mi g.yel grib bzhin 'grogs: des na rjes 'jug snying dang 'dra ba'i bu: ji bzhin bkod 'di nyams longs snying la rgya: ྈྈྈ dang po gtsang zhing yid 'ong dben pa'i sar: skyabs sems sngon 'gro bdag nyid rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni: stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje dkar gsal ni: shel ltar 'tsher ba rtse lnga rgya gram gyi: mtha' skor pad dkar dri med phreng ba dang: rdo rje'i ra ba dkar po me dpung gi: gur khang dbus su pad zlar rang rig ni: hūm̐ dkar ga pur zegs ma rab 'phro bas: 'phags pa mchod cing sems can sdig sgrib sbyangs: slar 'dus rang nyid rnam par 'joms pa'i sku: rab dkar zhi ma khro dbyibs spyan gsum 'bar: rdzi smin dbu skra dkar ser gyen du 'khyil: rin chen dbu rgyan snyan cha gdu bus mdzes: phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje thugs kar gtod: g.yon pa dngul gyi dril bu dku la brten: dri med lha yi na bza' lhab lhub gsol: rdo rje skyil krung cung zad 'gying tshul gyis: dpag yas 'od zer 'phro dbus lham mer bzhugs: gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od kyi 'phro 'du las: rang rig ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bstim: dbang gi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i chus:

khrus gsol rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgyas btab bsgom: slar yang thugs las sprul pa'i lha mos mchod: dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las mthu stobs kun: mi 'gyur gsang bdag thugs kyi lhar shar ba: rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs kar zla steng dkar gsal yi ge hūm̐: de mthar gzungs sngags snying pos bskor ba las: 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod cing mkha' khyab kyi: 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs: khyad par rang lus bdud rtsi dkar bsil gyis: rkang pa'i mtheb sor tshun gang nad gdon bgegs: sdig sgrib nyes ltung rgyud du 'khrigs pa kun: dud khu'i rnam par phyir thon rang gi lus: sgrib med shel gong phyis pa lta bu'i dbus: tsit+ta'i gur khang ting 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar: sngags kyi 'od dkar rab tu 'bar bar bsgom: na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya hu lu hu lu tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha bhan+dha bhan+dha ha na ha na a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa: bum chog byed na mdun du gzhi dkar por: bum gdan pad dkar 'dab brgyad lte ba'i dbus: chu yi gser ram dngul dkar bum pa ru: rgyun 'bab chu gtsang srog chags med pas bkang: nor bu yungs dkar dūrba rin po che: tsan+dan dkar po dri med legs btab pa: shel dang rdo rje me tog kha rgyan can: dri med ras dkar kha tshar mgul pa bcing: bum pa bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal med khang: nang du rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa bskyed: ye shes spyan drangs bstim zhing rgyas btab bya: mchod bstod gzungs sngags bzla bas sngags phreng dang: sku yi cha las ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun: babs pas bum chur gnyis su med thim bsam: mtha' mar lha yang 'od zhu bum chu dang: gcig tu gyur pa snod bcud dngos po'i rigs: gang la 'thor yang mi gtsang drungs 'byin cing: ye shes dag pa chen por sbyangs par blta: de nas bkru byab man ngag lde kha ni:

bsgrub bya re ba'i stan la gos nag gyon: mdun du khrus sder bum chu spyi bor blug: gzungs sngags sham bu a pa na ya btags: 'thor 'thung khrus bya dkar bsil bdud rtsi'i chus: spyi bo nas zhugs lus kyi phyi nang khyab: nad gdon sdig sgrib mi gtsang sangs kyis dag: slar yang ku sha rma bya'i mdongs kyi dbus: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sngags phreng bcas: 'od zer bzod dka' kun tu 'bar ba yis: sdig sgrib thams cad khrus chur bstim par bsam: ku sha rma bya'i mdongs kyis byab tshul bya: gzung sngags sham bur shān+tiṃ ku ru btag: de nas khrus chus brdzis pa'i ngar glud dang: changs bu brgya rtsa ting lo gtor zan rnams: brgya rtsa re bzhin sam+bha ras bsngo zhing: de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi yi mtshan brjod bya: thog med dus nas gnod cing 'tshe byed pa'i: 'byung po yi dwags sa 'og sa steng dang: sa blar rgyu ba kun la tshim par bsngo: bdag nyid rnam par 'joms pa'i nga rgyal gyis: drag sngags bzlas mthar thun brab spos kyis bdug: slar yang gdan gos dri med dkar po gyon: bsgrub bya rnam par 'joms pa'i sku ru bsgom: lus kyi gnas lnga tshigs chen bzhi dang rgyab: rdo rje rgya gram tshul bkod rtsa sngags kyi: sham bur rak+ṣa ku ru hūm̐ brjod pas: rdo rje dkar pos go mtshams med pa yi: phyur bur bltams pas mi chod mi shigs pa: srung ba'i go khrab rab tu 'bar bar bsgom: 'dis ni bdag gzhan sdig sgrib mi gtsang ba: nad gdon bgegs sogs gnod pa thams cad dang: mchog la sgrib pa kun las thar bar 'gyur: ma 'ongs o rgyan gsung sras snying thig tu: mi 'gyur rin chen snying gar a thaṃ rgya: sā mān: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ chos bdag bar chad sel ba'i chos ka rlung gi 'khor lo byams pa'i snying mdzod nas chos rje gling pas spyan drangs pa'o/// /
